about: TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION is the most lifelike tennis simulation ever released, showcasing the essence of gameplay on court and the challenge of managing a career through an entire season of 100 official tournaments against 150+ officially…
Now including the four Grand Slam events alongside the complete ATP and WTA tours, as well as team events United Cup and Laver Cup.
Feel the power of the racquet in the palms of your hand – there really hasn’t been a tennis experience like TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION!
A ROSTER OF UNPARALLELED QUALITY AND DEPTH

An unprecedented roster of professional men’s and women’s players, featuring immortal stars such as Novak Djokovic, Aryna Sabalenka, Roger Federer, Maria Sharapova, Rafael Nadal, and Caroline Wozniacki.
summary: Play the complete tennis season in TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION
